methods.label: Altitude and center-to-line distance
methods.explanation: Draw \(AD\perp BC\). Then \(D\) is the midpoint of \(BC\), \(BD=6\), and \(AD=\sqrt{10^2-6^2}=8\). The distance from the center to \(BC\) equals the radius, so the radius is 8.
